name: ICT Stupid-Simple (Sweep->IFVG->Trendline Break)

validation.selection: most-robust (max of min(IS,OOS)); not the lucky-OOS pick

notes: Honest result of aggressive grid + neighborhood search on real XAUUSD spread cost. Profitable on BOTH in-sample (1.05) and out-of-sample (1.43) halves, full-sample PF 1.23 — below the 1.3 live-promotion bar. HTF trend alignment (htf_bias) is the edge; displacement filter and longer HTF EMA did not beat this without overfitting. M1 timeframe had NO robust edge (in-sample PF up to 2.69 collapsed to <0.4 OOS = overfit). Runs PAPER only; the agent paper-gate (20 trades @ PF>=1.3) will not promote it to live until it proves >=1.3 on forward paper data. Not curve-fit to a fake number.
